findings.title: Bucket ACL allows anonymous access
findings.remediation: Set bucket ACL to private and use signed URLs or IAM policies.

findings.title: Default encryption disabled
findings.message: Bucket 'prod-backups-open' has no default server-side encryption.
findings.remediation: Enable default server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).

findings.title: Access logging disabled
findings.message: Bucket 'prod-backups-open' does not ship access logs.
findings.remediation: Enable access logging to a dedicated audit bucket.

findings.title: Object versioning disabled
findings.remediation: Enable versioning on production and backup buckets.

findings.title: Production-like bucket missing environment tag
findings.message: Bucket 'prod-backups-open' looks production-like but has no environment/env tag.
findings.remediation: Tag buckets with environment, owner, and data classification.

findings.title: Stale service account static key
findings.message: Service account key for ajeFAKESERVICEACCOUNT01 is 412 days old (policy threshold: 90 days).
findings.remediation: Rotate static keys regularly and prefer short-lived IAM tokens.

findings.title: Over-privileged storage principal
findings.message: Service account ajeFAKESERVICEACCOUNT01 has broad storage.admin access.
findings.remediation: Grant storage.viewer/editor scoped to required buckets only.

chains.title: Silent exfil path
chains.message: Bucket 'prod-backups-open' is exposed while logging and versioning are off — exfiltration may go unnoticed and objects cannot be rolled back.
